headline: A placebo landed inside the top 10 in 20 of 23 non-empty cells (expected 12.4 under the no-edge null), and at RANK 1 in 8 of them.  MCL_240_180=1/22, MCL_240_274=8/47, MCL_240_30=None/0, MCL_240_90=1/17, MCL_240_slice0=1/15, MCL_240_slice1=1/17, MCL_240_slice2=2/19, MCL_60_180=3/165, MCL_60_274=55/205, MCL_60_30=1/37, MCL_60_90=5/107, MCL_60_slice0=1/118, MCL_60_slice1=2/103, MCL_60_slice2=9/117, MGC_240_180=1/16, MGC_240_274=2/25, MGC_240_30=None/0, MGC_240_90=None/0, MGC_240_slice0=None/0, MGC_240_slice1=None/0, MGC_240_slice2=1/2, MGC_60_180=6/210, MGC_60_274=23/251, MGC_60_30=2/39, MGC_60_90=24/121, MGC_60_slice0=6/138, MGC_60_slice1=7/97, MGC_60_slice2=5/141. 0 rows cleared free_t anywhere; 11 of the 9-month top-10 rows were positive in all three disjoint thirds.

pooled_placebo_rank_uniformity.reading: Under the project's standing null - no rule set here has an edge - the controls' normalised ranks should be uniform. Systematically high (near 1.0) would mean the matching handicaps them and every real row above them is flattered; systematically low would mean the reals are worse than noise.

caveats: The four windows are nested (30d subset of 90d subset of 180d subset of 274d). Agreement across them is one observation seen four times, not replication. Only the three disjoint thirds carry replication weight.
Per symbol, never pooled. MGC and MCL are the two independent contracts here; no result from one is evidence about the other.

rth_only forced False on the whole generated population (D24): left True it reduces the 4h population to one bar per day and cost this cell a measured 102 vs 377 trades and 0 vs 6 floor-clearers on MGC 60m/300 rule sets. Applied identically to reals and placebos.

OPENING_RANGE dropped at 60m and 240m: an L-minute opening range is resolvable on a T-minute frame only if T divides L and T divides the RTH open in minutes from midnight (D39); 240m divides no OR length at all, and MGC's 08:20 open is not divisible by 60. Measured before dropping: 76 rule sets, 10 trades between them.

exit_at_session_close=True exits dropped at 240m only: it closes a 4-hour trade on its entry bar, median hold 0.0 minutes, so those rows are a different instrument rather than a slow strategy with a bad exit.

Clone collapse uses toolkit.fingerprint, which keys on (entry timestamp, direction) and ignores the exit. groups_spanning_different_exits counts how often that merged rule sets with different stop geometry; it was 0 in every cell run here.

A placebo rank must be read against null_rank. With k placebos among N rows and no edge anywhere, the best placebo's expected rank is (N+1)/(k+1) - about 11 at a 10% share. 'A placebo in the top 10' is only news relative to that number, which is why it is reported beside it.

placebo_rank_read_by_cell_size.why: A top-10 placebo only means something relative to the share of the table the controls occupy. In the thin cells the 12-placebo floor needed for any resolution at all pushes the control share to 40-71% of rows, and the best placebo is then expected at rank 1-4 whatever happens. Those cells are reported but they carry no evidential weight on this question.

large_cells_placebo_share_about_10pct.verdict: 9 of 12 against 7.6 expected, p=0.30. The controls are NOT beating the strategies more often than chance in the cells where the question can be asked - but they are not losing to them either, which is the finding: rank 1, 2, 3, 5, 5, 6, 6 and 7 for a deliberately empty rule set in tables of 97-210 rows.

thin_cells_placebo_share_40_to_71pct.verdict: Degenerate by construction. Report, do not interpret.

placebo_rank_read_by_cell_size.within_cell_dependence: The 3 placebos derived from one base strategy are not 3 independent controls - they share exits, filters and (for shift and shuffle) bar locations. MGC 240m 180d is the clearest case: its top four rows are all placebos, but three of the four come from the same base, so it is about two independent controls, not four.
